description: This source file defines test fixtures and collections used for Orleans-based testing, specifically for setting up clusters and environment fixtures related to Service Bus and Event Hub integrations within a testing framework.

classes.name: DefaultClusterTestCollection
classes.description: Defines a collection fixture for tests requiring a default Orleans cluster setup, sharing a single cluster instance.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentFixtureCollection
classes.description: Defines a fixture collection for tests requiring shared environment configuration, such as Service Bus and Event Hub setups.

classes.name: BaseEventHubTestClusterFixture
classes.description: An abstract base class for Event Hub integration test clusters, managing connectivity checks and stream queue initialization.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the fixture, waiting for Event Hub stream queue measurements.
